newsitem.title: MEXICO: Three die in Mexico bank raid shoot-out.
newsitem.headline: Three die in Mexico bank raid shoot-out.

text.p: Three people died during a gunbattle between police and armed robbers raiding a bank in the north of Mexico City on Thursday, police and news reports said.
Two of the dead were police who tried to stop the six gunmen raiding a branch of the Banco Union bank in the suburb of Atlampa. The third was a customer caught in the crossfire.
It was the third bank robbery this week in the Mexican capital and the eighth this year, authorities said.
